Parentheticals · 情景运用: A parenthetical is inserted in the middle of a sentence such as I think / to be frank / believe it or not; the word order stays unchanged.本课为情景运用练习,核心:Insert a component explaining attitude or source; it does not affect the sentence's grammar。
I think / I believe inserted in the middle|to be frank frankly speaking|believe it or not believe it or not|as a result / in fact|a parenthetical is separated from the sentence by commas
